And you can ask things like various statistical questions. So you can say, what was the billing issue? Will there be any changes? Okay. There was no billing issue mentioned in the conversation. Let's take a look. So right now we don't have enough data for topics. Let's take a look at if we ingested much more data. So we have a lot of sample data that I generated and I'll just load them all by one by one. And then this thing you can see generates a bunch of samples and it has nine different conversations. And now we have totally 10 different VCon's. And we can see there's an example of a WhatsApp chat. There's an example of a Teams call. There's an example of a direct, I believe this is a, yeah, this might be from the SIPREC. And then we can say something like, what was the most frequent issue? And then you can say billing and account reader were the most frequent, including duplicate charges. And then it gives you a list of the conversations where it was. This is the entire graph visualized from Neo4j to kind of show you how the conversations look like. And then let's take a look at, so there are totally three active agents. They might appear as multiple nodes because they might have independent interactions. But there are three unique agents. This is a timeline of all the sentiment analysis. And you can kind of take a look at the properties of each of these conversations and each of these agents in the node. So all in all, we kind of tried to hit a lot of the proposed functionality throughout the VCon proposals. So we do UNS. We have a direct MQTT connection and we do CIPREC as well as providing an interface for agentic AI to perform intelligence-based tasks based on VCon data that has been ingested. Okay, that kind of covers it. Thank you very much.
